questions.def: Use the same verb form after 'and' in a list.
questions.question: He likes ___, swimming, and running.

questions.def: Use the same infinitive form after 'and'.
questions.question: She wants to sing, ___, and dance.

questions.def: Maintain consistency: all gerunds or all infinitives.
questions.question: He enjoys to cook, to clean, and to read.

questions.def: Use gerund after 'at' to match the other items.
questions.question: He is good at ___ (cook), cleaning, and washing.

questions.def: Use same base form of the verb.
questions.question: I like to eat, sleep, and ___.

questions.def: Use same adjective form.
questions.question: She is intelligent, kind, and ___.

questions.def: Needs to be playing, singing, and dancing.
questions.question: He is good at playing, to sing, and dancing.

questions.def: Use gerund to keep parallel with writing and painting.
questions.question: She spends her time ___ (read), writing, and painting.

questions.def: Use the base form of the verb to be parallel.
questions.question: He needs to study, ___, and sleep.

questions.def: Use same gerund form.
questions.question: I enjoy swimming and ___ in the sea.

questions.def: The sentence should be 'to walk, to swim, and to run'.
questions.question: She likes to walk, swim, and to run.

questions.def: Use gerund to match the style.
questions.question: He likes ___ (play) football, basketball, and tennis.

questions.def: Use the gerund form.
questions.question: She is good at singing, ___, and dancing.

questions.def: Use the same adjective form.
questions.question: He is tall, dark, and ___.

questions.def: Use either all gerunds or all infinitives.
questions.question: She enjoys to read, writing, and painting.

questions.def: Use the infinitive form after 'to'.
questions.question: He likes to ___ (sing), to dance, and to play.

questions.def: Use the same noun form.
questions.question: She likes coffee, tea, and ___.

questions.def: Use same plural noun form.
questions.question: He likes to eat apples, bananas, and ___.

questions.def: The sentence should be 'He enjoys swimming, running, and playing'.
questions.question: He enjoys to swim, to run, and playing games.

questions.def: Use the gerund form to be parallel.
questions.question: She likes ___ (eat), drinking, and sleeping.

questions.def: Use the same adjective form.
questions.question: He is ___, kind, and helpful.

questions.def: Use the same gerund form.
questions.question: She enjoys reading books and ___ movies.

questions.def: Maintain consistency: all infinitives.
questions.question: He wants to buy a car, to travel, and relaxing.

questions.def: Use gerund after 'in' to match the other items.
questions.question: She is interested in ___ (learn), playing, and singing.

questions.def: Use same base form of the verb.
questions.question: She likes to cook, ___, and eat.

questions.def: Use same adjective form.
questions.question: He is happy, healthy, and ___.

questions.def: Maintain consistency: all gerunds or all infinitives.
questions.question: She likes to sing, dancing, and to act.

questions.def: Use gerund after 'at' to match the other items.
questions.question: He is good at ___ (write), reading, and speaking.

questions.def: Use the same plural noun form.
questions.question: He likes dogs, cats, and ___.

questions.def: Use the same infinitive form.
questions.question: She wants to sing, to play, and ___.
